newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda's Museveni wants Burundi leader removed.
newsitem.headline: Uganda's Museveni wants Burundi leader removed.

text.p: Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni said he wanted Burundian President Pierre Buyoya, who seized power in a July 25 coup, removed.
Museveni told a news conference on Tuesday: "For me to say that I am supporting this regime of Pierre Buyoya is an insult. For me, I actually want Buyoya removed."
Buyoya, a moderate ethnic Tutsi, replaced Hutu president Sylvestre Ntibantunganya. Regional leaders responded with economic sanctions on Burundi to protest against that coup.
Ntibantunganya took the Burundian presidency after the 1993 murder of president Melchior Ndadaye, who had won presidential elections earlier in that year.
Ndadaye's death plunged Burundi into anarchy. Normalcy has never returned since.
